model_submission.reason: The question asks for percentage change in after-tax share-based compensation cost. After-tax cost = share-based compensation cost + income tax benefit (since benefit is negative). We have source values for 2010 and 2009 for both components. Need to compute after-tax values for each year, then percentage change = ((2010 after-tax - 2009 after-tax) / 2009 after-tax) * 100. Currently only pre-tax values have been used; need to incorporate tax benefits.
model_submission.subgoal: Compute after-tax share-based compensation cost for 2010 and 2009 by adding the share-based compensation cost and income tax benefit for each year, then calculate percentage change from 2009 to 2010.
